title: Evaluation: Console plugin transformation and HotCRM integration strategy
body:
Evaluates transforming `@object-ui/console` from standalone app to publishable plugin for HotCRM integration.

## Approach

**Dual-mode package architecture:**
- Library build: 50-200KB tree-shakeable exports (components, hooks, types)
- App build: 5-10MB standalone deployment (preserves current functionality)
- Peer dependencies pattern prevents version conflicts, enables tree-shaking

**Three integration patterns:**
1. Full app embedding via `<ConsoleApp />` component
2. Component-level cherry-picking (ObjectView, DashboardView, etc.)
3. Hybrid approach mixing console + custom components (recommended)

## Implementation Path

```
apps/console/ → packages/plugin-console/
├── src/
│   ├── index.tsx              # Library exports + ComponentRegistry
│   ├── app.tsx                # Full app export
│   └── app-entry/main.tsx     # Standalone mode
└── vite.config.ts             # Dual build (--mode lib|app)
```

**Package changes:**
- `private: true` → `false`
- Direct deps → peer deps (React, Router, Core libs)
- Add UMD/ESM dual exports
- vite-plugin-dts for TypeScript types

## HotCRM Integration Example

```typescript
// Option A: Full embedding
import { ConsoleApp } from '@object-ui/plugin-console/app';

<ConsoleApp appConfig={hotcrmConfig} dataSource={dataSource} />

// Option B: Component-level
import { ConsoleLayout, ObjectView } from '@object-ui/plugin-console';

<ConsoleLayout appConfig={config}>
  <ObjectView objectName="contacts" />
  <CustomHotCRMDashboard />
</ConsoleLayout>
```

## Deliverables

- **CONSOLE_PLUGIN_EVALUATION.md**: Architecture analysis, transformation strategy, alternatives
- **CONSOLE_PLUGIN_MIGRATION_GUIDE.md**: 8-phase implementation steps with code samples
- **HOTCRM_INTEGRATION_EXAMPLE.md**: Complete working integration (package.json, vite config, app setup)
- **CONSOLE_PLUGIN_SUMMARY.md**: Visual diagrams, quick reference
- **CONSOLE_PLUGIN_DOCS_INDEX.md**: Navigation guide, role-based reading paths

## Timeline

6 weeks: 3 weeks transformation + 2 weeks testing/publishing + 1 week HotCRM integration

## Risks

- Breaking changes mitigated via app mode backward compatibility
- Type incompatibility handled with generic interfaces
- Bundle size managed via peer deps + tree-shaking
